meta.description: Recorded property transfers (commercial, industrial, apartments, vacant land AND residential/home sales) in Connecticut (Horton Electrical Services home state) and Rhode Island, for Commonwealth Electrical Technologies / Broad Sky Partners operating intelligence.
method: CT OPM: Socrata SODA GET https://data.ct.gov/resource/5mzw-sjtu.json (dataset now titled 'Real Estate Sales 2001-2024 GL', newest vintage; last updated 2026-08-12) with $select=*,:@computed_region_dam5_q64j,:@computed_region_nhmp_cq6b, $where=daterecorded>='2024-01-01' (all property types), $order=serialnumber,listyear,town, $limit=50000 paged with $offset 0/50000 -> 79,682 rows. ZIP from Socrata computed region nhmp-cq6b joined to ZCTA via https://data.ct.gov/resource/nhmp-cq6b.json; county from town via CT Towns crosswalk https://data.ct.gov/resource/5hqs-h5c3.json (FIPS county code; Norwich hard-mapped to New London). Records deduped on town+serial+list year+address+date+price (0 dups).

CT CAMA (fills OPM lag after 2025-09-30): ArcGIS FeatureServer query .../Connecticut_CAMA_and_Parcel_Layer/FeatureServer/0/query where=Sale_Date LIKE '9|10|11|12/%/2025 %' OR LIKE '%/2026 %' (Sale_Date is a text field), returnCentroid=true, outSR=4326, resultOffset paging by 2000 -> 30,645 parcels; kept sale_date 2025-10-01..2026-09-24 and Sale_Price>=2000 -> 14,963.

RI Cranston: ArcGIS Server FeatureServer/0 query where=RecordDate >= DATE '2025-09-01', returnGeometry=true outSR=4326 (centroid = vertex mean of outer ring), resultOffset paging by 2000 -> 2,538 deed records; kept SalesPrice>=2000 plus Warranty deeds (Deed_Type W) with $0 price (price=null, likely sales not yet priced); dropped QC/DB/easement/address-change/nominal -> 774.
RI Lincoln: ArcGIS hosted FeatureServer/0 query where=Sale_Date >= DATE '2024-07-01', returnCentroid=true, outSR=4326 -> 76; kept Price>=2000 -> 52.

Size control (<25 MB): all non-residential CT OPM rows since 2024-01-01 kept; CT OPM Residential rows kept only from 2025-06-01 onward (55,120 older residential rows from 2024-01-01..2025-05-31 dropped, not sampled); all CT CAMA residential kept. Items sorted by sale_date descending.

use_type: OPM Property Type mapped Residential->residential, Commercial->commercial, Industrial->industrial, Apartments->commercial, Vacant Land->land, Public Utility->other; CAMA/RI mapped by use description keywords, then first digit of state use code (1 res, 2 comm, 3 ind, 5-8 land, 4/9 other).

caveats: User request honored: home (residential) sales are included alongside commercial/industrial/apartment/land transfers; filter use_type for the CET commercial/industrial view.

CT OPM source lags: newest vintage (2024 Grand List) ends at Date Recorded 2025-09-30 (~12-month lag). Post-2025-09-30 CT sales come from the statewide CAMA parcel layer instead, which only holds each parcel's LAST sale (a parcel resold after its Oct-2025+ sale shows only the newer sale) and whose town extracts end between ~2026-01 and 2026-06 depending on town CAMA upload date; volume tails off after 2026-03.

CT OPM rows have no buyer/seller, year built, sqft or beds (null). CAMA/RI rows have buyer = current owner of record (assumed grantee of the listed last sale) and no seller; builder_flag is therefore null for every record (seller name unavailable in all sources).

arms_length: OPM true when no Non Use Code, false when a Non Use Code is present (e.g., family, foreclosure, multi-parcel, 'Other'); null for CAMA and RI sources (no validity code published). 'Apartments' (5+ units) tagged commercial.

Geo precision: OPM 'address' = OPM-published Location point; 1,285 OPM rows missing Location were placed at the median of geocoded OPM points in the same town (town centroid) and tagged geo_precision='zip' because the schema has no 'town' value - treat as town-level. CAMA/RI = parcel centroid.

CT counties are the 8 legacy counties (CT replaced counties with planning regions for Census purposes in 2022). CT OPM addresses are sometimes malformed (e.g., numeric-only) and are passed through as published.
Minimum price filter: $2,000 for all sources (matches OPM's own threshold); 152 Cranston warranty deeds recorded without a price carry price=null.

Rhode Island coverage is partial: only Cranston (current through 2026-05 priced, deeds through 2026-09) and Lincoln (stale; last sale 2025-06-27, window 2024-07-01..2025-06-27) in Providence County. No RI statewide sales source exists publicly; Kent, Washington, Newport and Bristol counties have no records.

QA 2026-09-24: Validated all 40,351 items (JSON parses, required fields present, sale_date in range 2015-01-01..2026-09-24, price>=1000 or null, addr/lat-lon present, lat/lon within CT/RI bounds, no duplicate ids). meta.coverage/counts_by_source sums matched actual per-county item counts exactly (no fix needed). Re-queried CT OPM source (data.ct.gov 5mzw-sjtu, serialnumber=24013&listyear=2024&town=Thompson) and confirmed match against item id=ct-opm-2024-24013-Thompson (address, sale amount 255000, date 2025-09-30, coordinates all matched). File size 22.8MB, under 30MB limit, no truncation needed. 0 items removed; meta.item_count unchanged at 40351. Grade: A.
Trimmed for CET use on 2026-09-24: kept commercial/industrial/mixed/other use types and land ≥ $500k (5,908 of 40,351 transfers); residential rows removed.

Reconciled 2026-09-24: removed 92 CT CAMA parcels with residential state use codes (1-family, condo, 2-4 family, manufactured home) that keyword mapping had tagged commercial/industrial/land; they are home sales and now live in sales/cet_home_sales_ct_ri.
